title: A Deadly Education
author: Naomi Novik
summary: At a magical school with no teachers and monsters hiding in every corridor, a sarcastic student with a gift for destruction just wants to survive until graduation. Then the most popular boy in school keeps saving her life.
readIf: you like a grim, snarky take on the magic school genre with a prickly narrator and clever worldbuilding.
skipIf: you want a cosy school story or dislike a narration that heavily explains how the magic works.

pairings.reason: The cheerful opposite: a magic school with real danger but also warmth and wonder.
Another bleak, adult-leaning take on magical education where talent has a real cost.
Another school-adjacent fantasy that is dark, violent and driven by a wary heroine.
